description: Pay a person or business a specified amount of USDC using only their email address. Provisions a Privy embedded wallet for the recipient automatically if they don't have one, then executes the transfer via Circle's Developer-Controlled Wallets / Arc rails.

healthCheck.note: Root (/) is the product's human-facing landing page, shared with this project's ETHOnline 2026 submission; the health check is exposed at /api/health instead. See SUBMISSION.md.

relatedSubmissions.note: Same underlying project (Arcway), submitted there as a human-facing dashboard targeting the Privy and Arc sponsor prize tracks.
